I will extract the invoice data from the CSV into structured JSON.

Mapping the CSV fields to the invoice schema. The due date is a calendar date, so due_date_as_written should be null.

The schema says due_date_as_written is null if absent. The instruction says dates are YYYY-MM-DD. I need to decide whether a calendar date belongs in the written field.

The invoice will contain one line item for WidgetA, quantity 10, unit price 250.00, and amount 2500.00. Subtotal is 2500.00, shipping is 75.00, total is 2475.00, and payment terms are Net 30. Tax, notes, revision, and corrections are null or empty. The total will be preserved exactly as written without recomputation.

The numeric values will be plain numbers without decimals. The total of 2475.00 is preserved exactly as written, and no correction is needed.
